+        if not {f'{name}.json', f'{name}.npubin'}.issubset(entries):
+            raise ValueError('missing metadata or binary')
+        allowed = {f'{name}.{ext}' for ext in ('json', 'npubin', 'source', 'ttir', 'ttadapter')}
+        if not entries.keys() <= allowed:
+            raise ValueError('unexpected artifact names')
+        group = {key: str(directory / key) for key in entries}
+        if _artifact_manifest(group, directory, variant) != manifest:
+            raise ValueError('artifact checksum or size changed')
+        with (directory / f'{name}.npubin').open('rb') as stream:
+            if stream.read(4) != b'\x7fELF':
+                raise ValueError('missing ELF binary header')
+        return group
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError) as error:
+        raise BatchCompileError(str(error), kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='validate') from error
+
+
+def _knob_overrides(group):
+    # A fresh interpreter already inherits the parent's environment. An unset
+    # variable and an explicitly set default can mean different things to CANN.
+    return {name: value for name, value in vars(group).items() if name in group.knob_descriptors}
+
+
+def _restore_knobs(knobs, body):
+    # Restore the Python view without invoking setters that write to os.environ.
+    vars(knobs.compilation).update(body['knobs'])
+    knobs.compilation.instrumentation_mode = body['instrumentation_mode']
+    vars(knobs.ascend).update(body['ascend_knobs'])
+    vars(knobs.cache).update(dir=body['cache_dir'], dump_dir=body['dump_dir'])
+    vars(knobs.autotuning).update(body['autotuning_knobs'])
+    knobs.propagate_env = body['propagate_env']
+
+
+_active_attempt = ContextVar('ascend_batch_compiler_attempt', default=None)
+
+
+class _CandidateStages:
+    """Child-only cache and stage binding for a single call to Triton's compiler."""
+
+    def __init__(self, source, directory, writer, prepared=None):
+        self.source, self.directory, self.writer = source, directory, writer
+        self.prepared = prepared
+        self.index_root = directory / 'core-cache'
+        self.decline = None
+        self.stop = Exception('candidate stage declined')
+
+    def bind_writer(self, source, index, options):
+        from triton import knobs
+        if (source is not self.source or options.block_batching_factor <= 1
+                or Path(index.cache_dir).parent != self.index_root):
+            raise BatchCompileError('worker stage writer identity mismatch', stage='cache')
+        # The core retains its private group manager. Backend tools and dumps use
+        # the original configuration for the actual compiler stages.
+        vars(knobs.cache)['dir'] = self.original_cache_dir
+        return self.writer
+
+    def wrap(self, ext, stage):
+
+        def run(module, metadata):
+            (self.directory / 'stage').write_text(ext)
+            if ext == 'ttir' and self.prepared is not None:
+                result = _restore_ttir(self.prepared, metadata, module.context, self.directory)
+            else:
+                result = stage(module, metadata)
+            if isinstance(result, BatchDecline):
+                if result.stage != ext:
+                    raise BatchCompileError('decline does not match the running stage', stage=ext)
+                self.decline = result
+                raise self.stop
+            return result
+
+        return run
+
+    def compile(self, compile_single, target, options, env_vars):
+        from triton import knobs
+        from triton.compiler.errors import MLIRCompilationError
+        # The request directory is private and new, so no existing ordinary
+        # group can be hit. The parent separately owns the generation directory.
+        self.index_root.mkdir()
+        if any(Path(self.writer.cache_dir).iterdir()):
+            raise BatchCompileError('candidate generation is not empty', stage='cache')
+        self.original_cache_dir = knobs.cache.dir
+        token = _active_attempt.set(self)
+        try:
+            vars(knobs.cache)['dir'] = str(self.index_root)
+            return compile_single(self.source, target, options, _env_vars=env_vars)
+        except MLIRCompilationError as error:
+            if error.__cause__ is self.stop and self.decline is not None:
+                return self.decline
+            raise
+        finally:
+            vars(knobs.cache)['dir'] = self.original_cache_dir
+            _active_attempt.reset(token)
+
+
+def _worker_input(body, directory):
+    from triton import knobs
+    from triton.backends.compiler import GPUTarget
+    from triton.compiler.compiler import make_backend
+    from .block_batching_source import FrozenSource
+    from .reuse.snapshot import decode
+    target = GPUTarget(**body['target'])
+    source = FrozenSource.from_wire(body['source'], directory)
+    _restore_knobs(knobs, body)
+    options = decode(body['options'])
+    backend = make_backend(target)
+    normalized = backend.parse_options(dict(options))
+    if normalized.block_compile_context is None:
+        raise ValueError('candidate worker requires explicit block_compile_context')
+    if _variant_key(source, backend, normalized, body['env_vars']) != body['variant']:
+        raise ValueError('worker source, backend, options or environment differ')
+    return source, backend, options, normalized
+
+
+def _compile(body, directory):
+    from dataclasses import asdict
+    from triton import knobs
+    from triton.compiler.compiler import _compile as compile_single
+    from triton.runtime.cache import FileCacheManager
+    source, backend, options, normalized = _worker_input(body, directory)
+    prepared = body.get('prepared')
+    if prepared is not None:
+        _check_ttir(prepared, body['variant'], normalized)
+    target = backend.target
+    cache = FileCacheManager(body['stage_key'])
+    stage_dir = Path(cache.cache_dir).resolve()
+    timings = {}
+    if body['timing']:
+
+        def collect(**kwargs):
+            timings.update(asdict(kwargs['times']))
+
+        knobs.compilation.listener = collect
+    candidate = _CandidateStages(source, directory, cache, prepared).compile(compile_single, target, options,
+                                                                             body['env_vars'])
+    if isinstance(candidate, BatchDecline):
+        return 'NotApplicable', candidate.payload()
+    if candidate.hash != body['variant']:
+        raise ValueError('compiled candidate identity differs')
+    manifest = _artifact_manifest(candidate.metadata_group, stage_dir, candidate.hash)
+    return 'Success', dict(manifest=manifest, timings=timings)
+
+
+def _worker():
+    # The bootstrap sets the core limit before Python processes site imports.
+    directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    request = json.loads((directory / 'request').read_bytes())
+    operation, body = request['operation'], request['body']
+    (directory / 'stage').write_text(operation)
+    try:
+        if request['protocol'] != _PROTOCOL or request['identity'] != _digest([operation, body]):
+            raise ValueError('invalid request identity')
+        if operation == 'compile':
+            status, payload = _compile(body, directory)
+        elif operation in ('analyze', 'probe'):
+            status, payload = _native_report(operation, body, directory)
+        elif operation == 'select':
+            from .block_auto import _select_ttir
+            source, backend, options, _ = _worker_input(body, directory)
+            report = _select_ttir(backend, source, options, body['env_vars'], body['contract'],
+                                  body['scalar_arguments'], Path(body['output']))
+            status, payload = 'Success', dict(report=report)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError('unknown worker operation')
+    except Exception as error:
+        status, payload = _classify(error, _stage(directory))
+    reply = {key: request[key] for key in ('protocol', 'id', 'identity', 'operation')}
+    reply.update(status=status, payload=payload)
+    (directory / 'result').write_text(json.dumps(reply, allow_nan=False))
+
+
+def _remove_stage(directory):
+    if directory.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(directory)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _cache_lock(directory):
+    """Serialize group reads and publication, never compilation, for one key."""
+    import fcntl
+    locks = directory.parent / '.block-locks'
+    locks.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    previous = directory.parent / '.block-staging' / (directory.name + '.previous')
+    with (locks / directory.name).open('a') as lock:
+        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        # Recover a writer interrupted between the two directory renames.
+        if previous.exists():
+            if directory.exists() and any(directory.glob('__grp__*.json')):
+                _remove_stage(previous)
+            else:
+                if directory.exists():
+                    directory.rmdir()  # Only an empty cache-manager placeholder is removable.
+                previous.replace(directory)
+        yield previous
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def flat_cache(variant):
+    from triton import knobs
+    from triton.runtime.cache import FileCacheManager, get_cache_manager, _base32
+    directory = Path(knobs.cache.dir).resolve() / _base32(variant)
+    with _cache_lock(directory):
+        cache = get_cache_manager(variant)
+        if type(cache) is not FileCacheManager or Path(cache.cache_dir).resolve() != directory:
+            raise BatchCompileError('nonlocal block cache', kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='cache')
+        yield cache
+
+
+def _new_stage(cache):
+    from triton.runtime.cache import FileCacheManager
+    directory = Path(cache.cache_dir).resolve().parent / '.block-staging' / uuid4().hex
+    return FileCacheManager(str(directory))
+
+
+def _publish_artifacts(cache, stage, group, manifest=None):
+    """Move validated files into the ordinary key directory without copying bytes."""
+    from triton.runtime.cache import FileCacheManager
+    directory = Path(cache.cache_dir).resolve()
+    flat = {name: str(directory / name) for name in group}
+    metadata_name, = (name for name in group if name.endswith('.json'))
+    writer = FileCacheManager(str(stage))
+    writer.put_group(metadata_name, flat)
+    if manifest is not None:
+        writer.put(json.dumps(manifest), _MANIFEST, binary=False)
+    with _cache_lock(directory) as previous:
+        if directory.exists():
+            directory.replace(previous)
+        try:
+            stage.replace(directory)
+        except BaseException:
+            # A signal can arrive after rename committed. Never remove the new
+            # visible group; a later reader can discard its previous backup.
+            if not directory.exists() and previous.exists():
+                previous.replace(directory)
+            raise
+        _remove_stage(previous)
+    return flat
+
+
+class _BaselineWriter:
+    """Stage F1 through the existing compiler and publish before its listener runs."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cache):
+        self.cache = cache
+        self.writer = _new_stage(cache)
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        return getattr(self.writer, name)
+
+    def commit(self, source, group, variant):
+        from triton.compiler.compiler import CompiledKernel
+        stage = Path(self.writer.cache_dir)
+        # Forced compilation can inherit old IR entries from get_group(). Only
+        # files produced in this attempt belong to the replacement directory.
+        group = {name: path for name, path in group.items() if Path(path).parent == stage}
+        result = CompiledKernel(source, group, variant)
+        if result.metadata.hash != variant:
+            raise BatchCompileError('baseline artifact identity mismatch', kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='cache')
+        result.metadata_group = _publish_artifacts(self.cache, stage, group)
+        return result
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def baseline_writer(cache):
+    writer = _BaselineWriter(cache)
+    try:
+        yield writer
+    finally:
+        _remove_stage(Path(writer.cache_dir))
+
+
+def _worker_request(backend, source, options, env_vars, variant):
+    from dataclasses import asdict
+    from triton import knobs
+    from .reuse.snapshot import encode
+    return dict(source=source.to_wire(), target=asdict(backend.target), env_vars=env_vars,
+                options=encode(dict(options)), variant=variant, cache_dir=str(Path(knobs.cache.dir).resolve()),
+                dump_dir=str(Path(knobs.cache.dump_dir).resolve()), knobs=_knob_overrides(knobs.compilation),
+                instrumentation_mode=knobs.compilation.instrumentation_mode, ascend_knobs=_knob_overrides(knobs.ascend),
+                autotuning_knobs=_knob_overrides(knobs.autotuning), propagate_env=knobs.propagate_env)
+
+
+def _cacheable_decline(payload):
+    return (isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.keys() <= {'reason', 'stage', 'analysis'}
+            and payload.get('stage') == 'ttir' and payload.get('reason') in _CACHEABLE_DECLINES
+            and ('analysis' not in payload or isinstance(payload['analysis'], dict)))
+
+
+def _candidate_cache(variant):
+    from triton.runtime.cache import get_cache_manager
+    return get_cache_manager(_digest(['batch_artifacts', _PROTOCOL, variant]))
+
+
+def _remember_decline(cache, variant, payload):
+    if _cacheable_decline(payload):
+        cache.put(json.dumps(dict(version=_PROTOCOL, variant=variant, decline=payload, digest=_digest(payload))),
+                  _DECLINE, binary=False)
+
+
+def _pack_ttir(module, metadata, output):
+    from triton._C.libtriton import ascend
+    data = ascend.serialize_block_input(module)
+    with output.open('xb') as stream:
+        stream.write(data)
+    return dict(variant=metadata['hash'], digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), report=metadata['block_batching'])
+
+
+def _check_ttir(prepared, variant, options):
+    """Bind the selected frontend to exactly the candidate being compiled."""
+    report = prepared['report']
+    if (prepared.keys() != {'variant', 'digest', 'path', 'report'} or prepared['variant'] != variant
+            or report.get('plan_id') != variant or report.get('compile_status') != 'REWRITTEN'
+            or report.get('owner') != 'block_batching'
+            or report.get('candidate_factor') != options.block_batching_factor
+            or report.get('requested_axis') != options.block_batching_axis
+            or report.get('selected_axis') not in (0, 1, 2)):
+        raise BatchCompileError('selected TTIR identity differs', kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='ttir')
+
+
+def _restore_ttir(prepared, metadata, context, directory):
+    from triton._C.libtriton import ir
+    if metadata['hash'] != prepared['variant']:
+        raise BatchCompileError('prepared TTIR cache identity differs', kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='ttir')
+    path = directory / 'selected.ttir'
+    data = Path(prepared['path']).read_bytes()
+    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != prepared['digest']:
+        raise BatchCompileError('selected TTIR bytes changed', kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='ttir')
+    path.write_bytes(data)
+    module = ir.parse_mlir_module(str(path), context)
+    module.context = context
+    metadata['block_batching'] = prepared['report']
+    return module
+
+
+def _cached_decline(cache, variant):
+    path = cache.get_file(_DECLINE)
+    if path:
+        try:
+            record = json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
+            payload = record['decline']
+            if (_cacheable_decline(payload) and type(record['version']) is int
+                    and record == dict(version=_PROTOCOL, variant=variant, decline=payload, digest=_digest(payload))):
+                return payload
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+            pass  # Incomplete or stale negative entries require fresh analysis.
+    return None
+
+
+class CandidateCompiler:
+    """Own one bundle request and at most one resource-directed retry."""
+
+    def __init__(self, backend, source, env_vars, *, prepared=None):
+        self.backend, self.source, self.env_vars = backend, source, dict(env_vars)
+        self.prepared = prepared
+
+    def _variant(self, options, pending, *, cached_only=False):
+        from triton import knobs
+        from triton.compiler.compiler import CompileTimer
+
+        listener = knobs.compilation.listener
+        timer = CompileTimer() if listener else None
+        normalized = self.backend.parse_options(dict(options))
+        variant = _variant_key(self.source, self.backend, normalized, self.env_vars)
+        if self.prepared is not None:
+            _check_ttir(self.prepared, variant, normalized)
+        name = self.source.name[:150]
+        if Path(name).name != name or not name:
+            raise BatchCompileError('invalid candidate artifact basename', kind='InvalidArtifact')
+        with ExitStack() as reading:
+            cache = reading.enter_context(flat_cache(variant))
+            index = cache.get_file(_MANIFEST)
+            if index and not knobs.compilation.always_compile:
+                try:
+                    manifest = json.loads(Path(index).read_bytes())
+                    group = _checked_group(manifest, Path(cache.cache_dir).resolve(), variant, name)
+                except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
+                    raise BatchCompileError(f'invalid published index: {error}', kind='InvalidArtifact',
+                                            stage='cache') from error
+                # Keep the read lock until CompiledKernel has read the complete
+                # group and the parent has bound its execution contract.
+                pending.enter_context(reading.pop_all())
+                return None, (cache, None, group, variant, timer.end() if timer else None)
+        if cached_only:
+            return None, None
+        decline_cache = _candidate_cache(variant)
+        if not knobs.compilation.always_compile:
+            refusal = _cached_decline(decline_cache, variant)
+            if refusal is not None:
+                return refusal, None
+        body = _worker_request(self.backend, self.source, options, self.env_vars, variant)
+        if self.prepared is not None:
+            body['prepared'] = self.prepared
+        stage_dir = Path(_new_stage(cache).cache_dir).resolve()
+        body.update(stage_key=str(stage_dir), timing=bool(listener))
+        pending.callback(_remove_stage, stage_dir)
+        outcome = _attempt('compile', body)
+        if outcome.status == 'NotApplicable':
+            refusal = outcome.payload
+            if (refusal['reason'] == 'LAYOUT_TARGET_RESOURCE_REJECTED'
+                    and (refusal.get('stage') != 'npubin' or refusal.get('factor') != normalized.block_batching_factor
+                         or refusal.get('axis') != normalized.block_batching_axis
+                         or normalized.block_batching_layout != 'auto')):
+                raise BatchCompileError('layout refusal does not match the attempt', kind='ProtocolError')
+            if refusal['reason'] in _RESOURCE_REASONS and (refusal.get('stage') != 'npubin'
+                                                           or not isinstance(refusal.get('diagnostic'), str)):
+                raise BatchCompileError('invalid resource refusal evidence', kind='ProtocolError')
+            _remember_decline(decline_cache, variant, refusal)
+            return refusal, None
+        manifest = outcome.payload['manifest']
+        group = _checked_group(manifest, stage_dir, variant, name)
+        try:
+            timings = knobs.CompileTimes(**outcome.payload['timings']) if timer else None
+        except (KeyError, TypeError) as error:
+            raise BatchCompileError('invalid compilation timing record', kind='ProtocolError') from error
+        return None, (cache, dict(stage=stage_dir, manifest=manifest), group, variant, timings)
+
+    def compile(self, baseline, options, request, positions, *, allow_layout_retry=True, cached_only=False):
+        with ExitStack() as pending:
+            return self._compile_and_bind(baseline, options, request, positions, pending, allow_layout_retry,
+                                          cached_only)
+
+    def _compile_and_bind(self, baseline, options, request, positions, pending, allow_layout_retry=True,
+                          cached_only=False):
+        from triton import knobs
+        from triton.compiler.compiler import CompiledKernel, _notify_compilation_listener
+        from .block_batching import BatchKernel, IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION
+        from .block_batching_report import validated_candidate_report
+        options = dict(options)
+        if cached_only:
+            decline, compiled = self._variant(options, pending, cached_only=True)
+            if compiled is None:
+                return None
+        else:
+            decline, compiled = self._variant(options, pending)
+        retry = None
+        if (allow_layout_retry and decline and decline['reason'] == 'LAYOUT_TARGET_RESOURCE_REJECTED'
+                and decline.get('stage') == 'npubin' and decline.get('factor') == request.factor
+                and decline.get('axis') == request.axis and options.get('block_batching_layout', 'auto') == 'auto'):
+            retry = {key: decline[key] for key in ('reason', 'stage', 'diagnostic')}
+            pending.close()
+            decline, compiled = self._variant(dict(options, block_batching_layout='semantic_only'), pending)
+        if decline:
+            return rejected_bundle(baseline, request, decline, positions, retry)
+        cache, record, group, variant, timings = compiled
+        try:
+            candidate = CompiledKernel(self.source, group, variant)
+            normalized = self.backend.parse_options(dict(options))
+            if (candidate.metadata.hash != variant or self.backend.target != candidate.metadata.target
+                    or candidate.metadata.block_batching_backend_revision != normalized.block_batching_backend_revision
+                    or json.dumps(candidate.metadata.block_compile_context) != json.dumps(
+                        normalized.block_compile_context)):
+                raise ValueError('artifact metadata disagrees with candidate identity')
+            report = validated_candidate_report(candidate, request, IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION)
+            if retry:
+                report['layout'] = dict(report['layout'], requested_policy='auto', selected_policy='semantic_only',
+                                        compile_fallback=retry)
+            bundle = BatchKernel(baseline, candidate, request, report, positions, publish_manifest=False)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise BatchCompileError(str(exc), kind='InvalidArtifact', stage='bind') from exc
+        if record is not None:
+            group = _publish_artifacts(cache, record['stage'], group, record['manifest'])
+            candidate.metadata_group = group
+        pending.close()
+        bundle.publish_manifest()
+        if knobs.compilation.listener:
+            _notify_compilation_listener(knobs.compilation.listener, src=self.source,
+                                         metadata=candidate.metadata._asdict(), metadata_group=group, times=timings,
+                                         cache_hit=record is None)
+        return bundle
+
+
+# Prepare and compile a baseline/candidate bundle.
+def analyze_request(mod, request, binding=None, *, report_listener=None):
+    """Run native preflight in a worker. Observe its completed report in the caller."""
+    if request.factor == 1:
+        return {
+            "report_version": 1, "compile_status": "DISABLED", "requested_factor": 1, "requested_axis": request.axis,
+            "applied_factor": 1, "owner": "none", "reason": "DISABLED"
+        }
+    # MLIR shapes and the native launch contract use signed i32 extents.
+    # A positive Python integer outside that capability is not a config error.
+    if request.factor > I32_MAX:
+        return {
+            "report_version": 1, "compile_status": "REJECTED", "requested_factor": request.factor, "requested_axis":
+            request.axis, "applied_factor": 1, "owner": "none", "reason": "FACTOR_OUT_OF_RANGE"
+        }
+    if binding is not None:
+        from types import BuiltinFunctionType
+        analyze = getattr(binding, 'analyze_block_batching', None)
+        if analyze is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("block_batching requires a matching rebuilt Ascend C++ extension")
+        # An arbitrary Python wrapper may itself call native MLIR. Only the
+        # canonical pybind function can be reconstructed in the new interpreter.
+        native_analyze = None
+        if isinstance(analyze, BuiltinFunctionType):
+            from triton._C.libtriton import ascend
+            native_analyze = getattr(ascend.passes.ttir, 'analyze_block_batching', None)
+        if analyze is not native_analyze:
+            raise BatchCompileError(
+                'custom analysis bindings cannot be reconstructed in the worker. '
+                'use report_listener to observe native reports', kind='UnsupportedBinding', stage='analyze')
+    report = isolated_report('analyze', str(mod), request.factor, request.axis)
+    if report_listener is not None:
+        from copy import deepcopy
+        report_listener(deepcopy(report))
+    return report
+
+
+def probe_request(mod, request, layout_policy='semantic_only', cv_batch_matmul=False):
+    if request.factor == 1 or request.factor > I32_MAX:
+        return analyze_request(mod, request)
+    return isolated_report('probe', str(mod), request.factor, request.axis, layout_policy, cv_batch_matmul)
+
+
+def _runtime_positions(src):
+    constants = getattr(src, "constants", {})
+    result = []
+    for index, name in enumerate(src.fn.arg_names):
+        signature = src.signature.get(name, src.signature.get(index))
+        if not isinstance(signature, str):
+            return BatchDecline("NESTED_SIGNATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "signature")
+        if signature != "constexpr" and (index, ) not in constants and index not in constants and name not in constants:
+            result.append(index)
+    return result
+
+
+def _freeze_source(backend, src, baseline_options, backend_revision, *, scalar_positions=()):
+    """Generate frontend IR once, then parse the same immutable snapshot per variant."""
+    import hashlib
+    from triton._C.libtriton import ascend, ir
+    from triton.compiler.compiler import ASTSource
+    from triton.runtime.cache import get_cache_manager
+    if not isinstance(src, ASTSource) or hasattr(src, "block_batching_source_hash"):
+        return src
+    options = backend.parse_options(baseline_options)
+    context = ir.context()
+    ir.load_dialects(context)
+    backend.load_dialects(context)
+    module = src.make_ir(backend.target, options, backend.get_codegen_implementation(options), backend.get_module_map(),

+#ifndef TRITON_TO_GRAPH_BLOCK_BATCHING_EXPR_H

+#include <cstdint>

+namespace mlir::triton::cfg {
+// Owned, immutable coordinate expressions. Coordinate IDs denote projections
+// in this access, not make_range SSA identity. No erased SSA value is retained.
+//
+// Deliberately free of any serialization: the JSON form is the compile-time to
+// run-time contract (see BatchFactsJSON.h), not a property of the data type.
+// Keeping it out means the judgment layer can depend on BatchExpr without
+// pulling in llvm/Support/JSON.h.
+struct BatchExpr;
+using BatchExprRef = std::shared_ptr<const BatchExpr>;
+struct BatchExpr {
+  enum Kind {
+    Constant,
+    Argument,
+    Program,
+    ProgramQuotient,
+    ProgramRemainder,
+    Grid,
+    Coordinate,
+    Induction,
+    Add,
+    Sub,
+    Mul,
+    ExtSI,
+    ExtUI,
+    Trunc,
+    True,
+    False,
+    Unknown,
+    And,
+    SLT,
+    ULT,
+    EQ,
+    MinSI,
+    MaxSI
+  };
+  Kind kind;
+  unsigned bits = 0;
+  int64_t value = 0, extent = 0;
+  BatchExprRef lhs, rhs;
+  bool rangeOrigin = false;
+  // An empty expression or an unproved bound has no constant or interval.
+  static std::optional<int64_t> constant(const BatchExprRef &);
+  static std::optional<std::pair<int64_t, int64_t>>
+  rangeOf(const BatchExprRef &);
+  static int64_t largestKnownDivisor(const BatchExprRef &);
+  static bool isLaneUniform(const BatchExprRef &, unsigned mergeAxis);
+  static BatchExprRef range(BatchExprRef start, BatchExprRef projection);
+  static BatchExprRef leaf(Kind kind, int64_t value = 0, unsigned bits = 0,
+                           int64_t extent = 0);
+  static BatchExprRef node(Kind kind, unsigned bits, BatchExprRef lhs,
+                           BatchExprRef rhs = {}, unsigned sourceBits = 0);
+};
+} // namespace mlir::triton::cfg
+#endif

+// Copyright (c) Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 2026. All rights reserved.
+#ifndef TRITON_TO_GRAPH_BLOCK_BATCHING_LOOP_FACTS_H
+#define TRITON_TO_GRAPH_BLOCK_BATCHING_LOOP_FACTS_H
+#include "TritonToGraph/BlockBatching/BatchExpr.h"
+
+namespace mlir::triton::cfg {
+
+// One enclosing scf::ForOp of an access, innermost first. A pure value type:
+// the owned BatchExpr DAGs outlive the original body, nothing else does.
+//
+// Only what the loop literally is. Everything derivable from these three
+// expressions -- constant step, trip count, divisibility, lane uniformity --
+// is answered on demand on the BatchExpr DAG, so there is no field here that
+// can be stale or unfilled.
+struct BatchLoopFact {
+  unsigned id = 0;
+  unsigned bits = 0;
+  BatchExprRef lower, upper, step;
+  // Whether the loop carries any value from one iteration to the next, i.e.
+  // !scf::ForOp::getInitArgs().empty(). This is the one thing about the loop
+  // that the three expressions above cannot answer, and the gates do ask it:
+  // a cross-row accumulation (dW_row += ...) is exactly an iter_arg, and
+  // re-grouping rows across lanes would re-associate it.
+  //
+  // Counting iter_args rather than recognising accumulations on purpose: zero
+  // means "provably no cross-row carry", which is all a gate needs to let a
+  // loop through. Telling a real accumulation from a pass-through would need
+  // the yield chain, and today it would not admit one extra operator.
+  //
+  // Defaults to the restrictive answer so a producer that forgets to fill it
+  // makes gates reject rather than silently allow.
+  bool carriesValues = true;
+};
+
+// Serialization belongs to the output format, not the data types; see
+// BatchFactsJSON.h.
+
+} // namespace mlir::triton::cfg
+#endif

+#ifndef TRITON_TO_GRAPH_BLOCK_BATCHING_LOOP_SCHEDULE_H
+#define TRITON_TO_GRAPH_BLOCK_BATCHING_LOOP_SCHEDULE_H
+#include "TritonToGraph/BlockBatching/BatchLoopFacts.h"

+namespace mlir::triton::cfg {
+// Layer 2 contract: every entry point in this header is a pure predicate.
+// It takes facts and returns a verdict. It must not take a ModuleOp, must not
+// create or erase any operation, and must be callable before any rewrite has
+// happened. Mirrors llvm::isSafeToUnrollAndJam.
+
+// Original program coordinates, independent of the selected lowering.
+// Cyclic: lower = p*R, step = G*R. Program-lane batching retains each
+// original program's rows and stride under a folded launch grid.
+// Blocked: constant positive step and a proved uniform or per-program segment.
+// SequentialIterations uses these same facts but retains the original grid,
+// tile width, recurrence ownership and order within each program.
+struct BatchLogicalAxis {
+  enum Distribution : uint8_t { Cyclic, Blocked };
+  Distribution distribution = Cyclic;
+  unsigned loopID = 0;
+  int gridAxis = -1;
+  // Rows covered by one iteration: R for cyclic distribution, always 1 for
+  // blocked distribution, which advances by its step rather than chunk width.
+  int64_t chunk = 1;
+};
+
+// The existing coordinate proof also identifies program-owned recurrences.
+// Group their consecutive iterations without moving rows between programs or
+// reassociating carried values. The runtime proof checks the new arithmetic.
+enum class BatchSchedule { ProgramLanes, SequentialIterations };
+BatchSchedule selectBatchLoopLowering(const BatchLoopFact *loop,
+                                      const BatchLogicalAxis *axis,
+                                      int64_t factor);
+
+// Normalize one loop, not a set of accesses: coordinates are a loop property.
+// The form check used by BatchLoopLegality enforces a single program-axis loop
+// at function top level; that check does not belong here.
+//
+// No factor argument is needed. Factor-dependent checks such as T >= F and
+// F <= R belong to the main legality predicate.
+BatchResult<BatchLogicalAxis>
+normalizeBatchLoopCoordinates(const BatchLoopFact &loop, int gridAxis);
+
+// Replace this loop's induction variable in an access expression with its
+// lower bound plus an iteration offset:
+//
+//     Induction(id) = loop.lower + Induction(id)'
+//
+// The primed term denotes 0, step, 2*step, ... and is uniform across lanes.
+// Lane variation resides in lower: both cyclic and blocked segments start at
+// p*R and use a uniform step. Substitution exposes the program ID in the
+// address while keeping the iteration offset uniform.
+//
+// Layout analysis looks for K::Program in byteOffset. Without substitution,
+// the program ID remains hidden in the loop's lower bound, so a row access
+// would incorrectly appear to be SHARED_ACCESS.
+//
+// Return null if substitution cannot be proved, including a missing lower
+// bound. Callers must not fall back to the original expression. Expressions
+// independent of this induction variable retain their original pointer.
+BatchExprRef normalizeBatchAccessOnLogicalAxis(const BatchExprRef &e,
+                                               const BatchLoopFact &loop);
+} // namespace mlir::triton::cfg
+#endif

+// unsafe arithmetic must never reach the SCF unroller, even in a dead
+// candidate.
+enum class BatchLoopArithmetic { StaticSafe, NeedsRuntimeGuard, Unsafe };
+BatchLoopArithmetic batchLoopIterationArithmetic(const BatchLoopFact &loop,
+                                                 int64_t factor);
+// Largest d dividing every possible trip count. 1 when nothing is proven;
+// d % factor == 0 is what lets the rewrite skip the tail mask.
+int64_t batchLoopTripCountDivisor(const BatchLoopFact &loop);

+# Copyright (c) Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 2026. All rights reserved.
+"""Exercise the production block-batching binding for FileCheck tests."""
+import argparse
+
+from triton._C.libtriton import ascend, ir
+
+parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+parser.add_argument('source')
+parser.add_argument('--factor', type=int, default=2)
+parser.add_argument('--axis', type=int, default=0)
+parser.add_argument('--layout', default='auto')
+parser.add_argument('--cv', action='store_true')
+parser.add_argument('--batch-matmul', action='store_true')
+args = parser.parse_args()
+context = ir.context()
+ir.load_dialects(context)
+ascend.ir.load_dialects(context)
+module = ir.parse_mlir_module(args.source, context)
+module.context = context
+assert module.verify()
+before = str(module)
+report = ascend.passes.ttir.rewrite_block_batching(module, args.factor, args.axis, args.layout, args.cv,
+                                                   args.batch_matmul)
+assert module.verify()
+for key in ('compile_status', 'reason', 'selected_axis', 'cv_lowering', 'vv_lowering'):
+    if key in report:
+        print(f'// {key}: {report[key]}')
+if report['compile_status'] == 'REJECTED':
+    assert str(module) == before, 'A rejected rewrite changed the original module'
+    print('// unchanged: true')
+print(module)

+def parse(tmp_path, text):

+    context = ir.context()
+    ir.load_dialects(context)
+    ascend.ir.load_dialects(context)
+    path = tmp_path / 'batch.ttir'

+def pointwise(axis):
+    return '''module {
+  tt.func public @arbitrary_name(%x: !tt.ptr<f32>, %y: !tt.ptr<f32>, %n: i32) {
+    %p = tt.get_program_id AXIS : i32
+    %g = tt.get_num_programs AXIS : i32
+    %gf = arith.sitofp %g : i32 to f32
+    %gv = tt.splat %gf : f32 -> tensor<4xf32>
+    %b = arith.constant 4 : i32
+    %base = arith.muli %p, %b : i32
+    %range = tt.make_range {start = 0 : i32, end = 4 : i32} : tensor<4xi32>
+    %basev = tt.splat %base : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %idx = arith.addi %basev, %range : tensor<4xi32>
+    %nv = tt.splat %n : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %mask = arith.cmpi slt, %idx, %nv : tensor<4xi32>
+    %xp = tt.splat %x : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %yp = tt.splat %y : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %xa = tt.addptr %xp, %idx : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %ya = tt.addptr %yp, %idx : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %zero = arith.constant dense<0.0> : tensor<4xf32>
+    %v = tt.load %xa, %mask, %zero : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %result = arith.addf %v, %gv : tensor<4xf32>

+def analyze(tmp_path, text, factor=3, axis=0):
+    from triton._C.libtriton import ascend

+def reduction_ir(kind):

+  tt.func public @block_batching_elementwise(%x: !tt.ptr<f32>, %y: !tt.ptr<f32>, %n: i32) {
+    %p = tt.get_program_id x : i32
+    %g = tt.get_num_programs x : i32
+    %b = arith.constant 4 : i32
+    %base = arith.muli %p, %b : i32
+    %range = tt.make_range {start = 0 : i32, end = 4 : i32} : tensor<4xi32>
+    %basev = tt.splat %base : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %idx = arith.addi %basev, %range : tensor<4xi32>
+    %nv = tt.splat %n : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %mask = arith.cmpi slt, %idx, %nv : tensor<4xi32>
+    %xp = tt.splat %x : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %yp = tt.splat %y : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %xa = tt.addptr %xp, %idx : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %ya = tt.addptr %yp, %idx : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %onef = arith.constant dense<1.0> : tensor<4xf32>
+    %twof = arith.constant dense<2.0> : tensor<4xf32>
+    %onei = arith.constant dense<1> : tensor<4xi32>
+    %twoi = arith.constant dense<2> : tensor<4xi32>
+    %fouri = arith.constant dense<4> : tensor<4xi32>
+    %thirtytwo = arith.constant dense<32> : tensor<4xi32>
+    %big = arith.constant dense<1073741824> : tensor<4xi32>
+    %v = tt.load %xa, %mask, %onef : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %pv = tt.splat %p : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %gv = tt.splat %g : i32 -> tensor<4xi32>
+    %iv = arith.addi %pv, %onei : tensor<4xi32>
+    %signed = arith.subi %iv, %fouri : tensor<4xi32>
+    %denom = arith.subi %gv, %pv : tensor<4xi32>
+    %denomf = arith.sitofp %denom : tensor<4xi32> to tensor<4xf32>
+    %shift = arith.subi %thirtytwo, %denom : tensor<4xi32>
+    %op_out = "arith.maximumf"(%v, %denomf) : (tensor<4xf32>, tensor<4xf32>) -> tensor<4xf32>
+    tt.store %ya, %op_out, %mask : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    tt.return
+  }
+}"""
+    old = '%op_out = "arith.maximumf"(%v, %denomf) : (tensor<4xf32>, tensor<4xf32>) -> tensor<4xf32>'
+    scan = kind in ("scan", "reverse_scan", "tuple_scan")
+    tuple_ = kind in ("argmax", "argmax_index", "tuple_scan", "maxnum_capture")
+    op, ret = ("tt.scan", "tt.scan.return") if scan else ("tt.reduce", "tt.reduce.return")
+    args = "%v, %range" if tuple_ else "%v"
+    inputs = "tensor<4xf32>, tensor<4xi32>" if tuple_ else "tensor<4xf32>"
+    result_types = ("tensor<4xf32>, tensor<4xi32>" if tuple_ else "tensor<4xf32>") if scan else (
+        "f32, i32" if tuple_ else "f32")
+    result_names = "%reduced, %index" if tuple_ else "%reduced"
+    attributes = "axis = 0 : i32"
+    if scan:
+        attributes += ", reverse = " + ("true" if kind == "reverse_scan" else "false")
+    parameters = "%lhs_value: f32, %lhs_index: i32, %rhs_value: f32, %rhs_index: i32" if tuple_ else "%lhs_value: f32, %rhs_value: f32"
+    if kind in ("argmax", "argmax_index"):
+        combiner = '''%gt = arith.cmpf ogt, %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        %eq_values = arith.cmpf oeq, %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        %lhs_nan = arith.cmpf uno, %lhs_value, %lhs_value : f32
+        %rhs_nan = arith.cmpf uno, %rhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        %both_nan = arith.andi %lhs_nan, %rhs_nan : i1
+        %eq = arith.ori %eq_values, %both_nan : i1
+        %true = arith.constant true
+        %rhs_number = arith.xori %rhs_nan, %true : i1
+        %lhs_nan_first = arith.andi %lhs_nan, %rhs_number : i1
+        %greater = arith.ori %gt, %lhs_nan_first : i1
+        %smaller = arith.cmpi slt, %lhs_index, %rhs_index : i32
+        %tie = arith.andi %eq, %smaller : i1
+        %pick = arith.ori %greater, %tie : i1
+        %value = arith.select %pick, %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        %which = arith.select %pick, %lhs_index, %rhs_index : i32
+        tt.reduce.return %value, %which : f32, i32'''
+    elif kind == "maxnum_capture":
+        # The runtime scalar is used only by the terminator, never by an
+        # ordinary combiner operation. Both tuple results remain observable.
+        combiner = """%value = arith.maxnumf %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        tt.reduce.return %value, %n : f32, i32"""
+    elif kind == "tuple_scan":
+        combiner = '''%value = arith.addf %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32
+        %which = arith.addi %lhs_index, %rhs_index : i32
+        tt.scan.return %value, %which : f32, i32'''
+    else:
+        function = "arith.maximumf" if kind == "max" else "arith.maxnumf" if kind == "maxnum" else "arith.addf"
+        combiner = f'%value = {function} %lhs_value, %rhs_value : f32\n        {ret} %value : f32'
+    body = f'''{result_names} = "{op}"({args}) <{{{attributes}}}> ({{
+      ^bb0({parameters}):
+        {combiner}
+    }}) : ({inputs}) -> ({result_types})
+'''
+    if tuple_:
+        input_type = "tensor<4xi32>" if scan else "i32"
+        output_type = "tensor<4xf32>" if scan else "f32"
+        body += f'    %float_index = arith.sitofp %index : {input_type} to {output_type}\n'
+        body += f'    %combined = arith.addf %reduced, %float_index : {output_type}\n'
+        result = "%float_index" if kind == "argmax_index" else "%combined"
+    else:
+        result = "%reduced"
+    body += f'    %op_out = arith.addf {result}, %onef : tensor<4xf32>' if scan else f'    %op_out = tt.splat {result} : f32 -> tensor<4xf32>'
+    return text.replace(old, body)

+def symbolic_memory_ir(axis=0, mode="plain", origin=0):
+    stride = "%sx"
+    prelude = ""

+        prelude = "%sx2 = arith.muli %sx, %sy : i32"

+    %localv = tt.broadcast %r : tensor<2x1xi64> -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %pm = arith.muli %pv, %sxv : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %rm = arith.muli %localv, %syv : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %xm = arith.addi %pm, %rm : tensor<2x4xi64>"""

+  tt.func public @symbolic_rows(%x: !tt.ptr<f32>, %y: !tt.ptr<f32>, %nr: i32, %nc: i32, %sx: i32, %sy: i32) {{

+    %two = arith.constant 2 : i64
+    %base = arith.muli %pw, %two : i64
+    %rr = tt.make_range {{start = {origin} : i32, end = {origin+2} : i32}} : tensor<2xi32>
+    %cc = tt.make_range {{start = 0 : i32, end = 4 : i32}} : tensor<4xi32>
+    %rw = arith.extsi %rr : tensor<2xi32> to tensor<2xi64>
+    %cw = arith.extsi %cc : tensor<4xi32> to tensor<4xi64>
+    %r = tt.expand_dims %rw {{axis = 1 : i32}} : tensor<2xi64> -> tensor<2x1xi64>
+    %c = tt.expand_dims %cw {{axis = 0 : i32}} : tensor<4xi64> -> tensor<1x4xi64>
+    %bv = tt.splat %base : i64 -> tensor<2x1xi64>
+    %row = arith.addi %bv, %r : tensor<2x1xi64>
+    %rows = tt.broadcast %row : tensor<2x1xi64> -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %cols = tt.broadcast %c : tensor<1x4xi64> -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %nrw = arith.extsi %nr : i32 to i64
+    %ncw = arith.extsi %nc : i32 to i64
+    %nrv = tt.splat %nrw : i64 -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %ncv = tt.splat %ncw : i64 -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %mr = arith.cmpi slt, %rows, %nrv : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %mc = arith.cmpi slt, %cols, %ncv : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %mask = arith.andi %mr, %mc : tensor<2x4xi1>
+    {prelude}
+    %sxw = arith.extsi {stride} : i32 to i64
+    %syw = arith.extsi %sy : i32 to i64
+    %sxv = tt.splat %sxw : i64 -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %syv = tt.splat %syw : i64 -> tensor<2x4xi64>
+    {row_offset}
+    %ym = arith.muli %rows, %syv : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %xo = arith.addi %xm, %cols : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %yo = arith.addi %ym, %cols : tensor<2x4xi64>
+    %xp = tt.splat %x : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<2x4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %yp = tt.splat %y : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<2x4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    %xa = tt.addptr %xp, %xo : tensor<2x4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<2x4xi64>

+    %g = tt.get_num_programs x : i32

+def tile_reduction_ir(form):
+    import re
+    source = re.sub(r'%r\b', '%row_offset', tiled_scan_ir()).replace('%column', '%column_pid')
+    begin, end = source.index('    %out ='), source.index('    tt.store')
+
+    def reduce(name, value, shape, axis, result):
+        return f'''    %{name} = "tt.reduce"(%{value}) <{{axis = {axis} : i32}}> ({{
+          ^bb0(%a: f32, %b: f32):
+            %s = arith.addf %a, %b : f32
+            tt.reduce.return %s : f32
+        }}) : (tensor<{shape}xf32>) -> {result}
+'''
+
+    body = reduce('r', 'v', '4x4', 1, 'tensor<4xf32>')
+    value = 'r'
+    if form == 'elementwise':
+        body += '    %r2 = arith.addf %r, %r : tensor<4xf32>\n'
+        value = 'r2'
+    elif form in ('loop', 'loop_row'):
+        body += '''    %zero = arith.constant 0 : i32
+    %one = arith.constant 1 : i32
+    %r2 = scf.for %i = %zero to %n step %one iter_args(%acc = %r) -> (tensor<4xf32>) : i32 {
+      %next = arith.addf %acc, %r : tensor<4xf32>
+      scf.yield %next : tensor<4xf32>
+    }
+'''
+        value = 'r2'
+    elif form == 'branch':
+        body += '''    %cond = arith.cmpi slt, %row, %n : i32
+    %r2 = scf.if %cond -> (tensor<4xf32>) {
+      scf.yield %r : tensor<4xf32>
+    } else {
+      %next = arith.addf %r, %r : tensor<4xf32>
+      scf.yield %next : tensor<4xf32>
+    }
+'''
+        value = 'r2'
+    if form in ('row', 'loop_row'):
+        body += f'''    %expanded = tt.expand_dims %{value} {{axis = 1 : i32}} : tensor<4xf32> -> tensor<4x1xf32>
+    %broadcast = tt.broadcast %expanded : tensor<4x1xf32> -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+    %biased = arith.addf %v, %broadcast : tensor<4x4xf32>
+'''
+        body += reduce('again', 'biased', '4x4', 1, 'tensor<4xf32>')
+        body += '''    %e = tt.expand_dims %again {axis = 1 : i32} : tensor<4xf32> -> tensor<4x1xf32>
+    %out = tt.broadcast %e : tensor<4x1xf32> -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+'''
+    elif form in ('singleton', 'transpose'):
+        if form == 'singleton':
+            body += '    %e = tt.reshape %r : tensor<4xf32> -> tensor<1x4xf32>\n'
+        else:
+            body += '''    %column = tt.expand_dims %r {axis = 1 : i32} : tensor<4xf32> -> tensor<4x1xf32>
+    %e = tt.trans %column {order = array<i32: 1, 0>} : tensor<4x1xf32> -> tensor<1x4xf32>
+'''
+        body += reduce('last', 'e', '1x4', 1, 'tensor<1xf32>')
+        body += '''    %e2 = tt.expand_dims %last {axis = 1 : i32} : tensor<1xf32> -> tensor<1x1xf32>
+    %out = tt.broadcast %e2 : tensor<1x1xf32> -> tensor<4x4xf32>
+'''
+    else:
+        body += reduce('last', value, '4', 0, 'f32')
+        body += '    %out = tt.splat %last : f32 -> tensor<4x4xf32>\n'
+    return source[:begin] + body + source[end:]
+

+def grouped_dot(A, B, C, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr, MODE: tl.constexpr, LOOP: tl.constexpr,
+                INTEGER: tl.constexpr, T: tl.constexpr = 32):
+    p = tl.program_id(0)
+    r, c, k = tl.arange(0, T), tl.arange(0, T), tl.arange(0, T)
+    if MODE == 0:
+        r = p * T + r
+    elif MODE == 1:
+        c = p * T + c

+            a = tl.load(A + r[:, None] * K + kk[None, :], (r[:, None] < M) & (kk[None, :] < K), 0)
+            b = tl.load(B + kk[:, None] * N + c[None, :], (kk[:, None] < K) & (c[None, :] < N), 0)

+def row_softmax_with_weight(X, W, Y, N: tl.constexpr, STRIDE: tl.constexpr, B: tl.constexpr):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.arange(0, B)
+    value = tl.load(X + row * STRIDE + col, col < N, other=-float('inf'))
+    weight = tl.load(W + col, col < N, other=0)
+    exponent = tl.exp(value - tl.max(value, 0))

+    block = tl.program_id(0)

+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('rank', [0, 1, 4, 8, 19])
+def test_affine_arithmetic_preserves_values_and_dimensions(rank):
+    cls = guard_module.Affine
+    rng = random.Random(9741 + rank)
+    for _ in range(100):
+        a, b = (cls(rng.randrange(-2**63, 2**63), tuple(rng.randrange(-8, 9) for _ in range(rank))) for _ in range(2))
+        for sign in [-1, 1]:
+            assert a.add(b, sign=sign) == cls(a.offset + sign * b.offset,
+                                              tuple(x + sign * y for x, y in zip(a.coefficients, b.coefficients)))
+        scaled = a.scale(scale=-3)
+        assert scaled.offset == -3 * a.offset
+        assert scaled.coefficients == tuple(-3 * x for x in a.coefficients)
+        assert a.uniform == all(x == 0 for x in a.coefficients)
+        counts = tuple(rng.randrange(1, 8) for _ in range(rank))
+        deltas = [k * (n - 1) for k, n in zip(a.coefficients, counts)]
+        assert a.bounds(counts) == (a.offset + sum(min(0, v)
+                                                   for v in deltas), a.offset + sum(max(0, v) for v in deltas))
+    assert cls(3).coefficients == (0, 0, 0, 0)
+    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
+        a.offset = 0
+

+def test_affine_refuses_mismatched_dimensions_and_keeps_concrete_result_type():
+
+    class Derived(guard_module.Affine):
+        pass
+
+    assert type(Derived(2).scale(scale=3)) is guard_module.Affine
+    assert Derived(1, (1, 2)).add(guard_module.Affine(2, (3, 4))).coefficients == (4, 6)
+    # Zipping down to the shorter operand used to drop the remaining
+    # coefficients silently, which under-estimates the proved address range
+    # and is therefore unsafe in the permissive direction. Refuse instead.
+    with pytest.raises(guard_module.GuardFailure, match='AFFINE_DIMENSION_MISMATCH'):
+        Derived(1, (1, 2)).add(guard_module.Affine(2, (3, )))
+    with pytest.raises(guard_module.GuardFailure, match='AFFINE_DIMENSION_MISMATCH'):
+        guard_module.Affine(1, (1, 2)).bounds((4, ))

+def test_dispatch_keeps_gate_order_and_schedule_grid(bundle_environment, monkeypatch, grid, cv, preserve, capture,
+                                                     floor, expected, queries):
+    env = bundle_environment
+    env.report["cv_mode"] = "independent_batch_v1" if cv else "disabled"
+    calls = []
+
+    def query_capture():
+        calls.append('capture')
+        return capture
+
+    def query_floor():
+        calls.append('floor')
+        return floor
+
+    def guard(args, original_grid):
+        calls.append('guard')
+        assert original_grid == grid
+        return True, 'PROVEN_AT_RUNTIME'
+
+    report_module = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + '.block_batching_report')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(report_module, 'validate_vv_loop_contract', lambda metadata: preserve)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(guard_module, 'RuntimeGuard', lambda specification, factor: guard)
+    env.wrapper = batching.BatchKernel(env.base, env.candidate, batching.BatchRequest(3, 0), env.report, [0, 1, 2, 3])
+    env.wrapper._init_handles()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(batching, '_capture_state', query_capture)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(batching, '_core_floor', query_floor)
+    env.wrapper._dispatch(*grid, *env.launch[3:])
+    report = env.wrapper.last_launch

+    assert report.get('reason', report['runtime_status']) == expected
+    if expected == 'PROVEN_AT_RUNTIME':

+        assert report['grouping'] == ('loop_iterations' if preserve else 'programs')
+    elif expected == 'EMPTY_GRID':
+        assert not env.launches
+    else:

+def test_concurrent_publishers_preserve_flat_group_identity(tmp_path):
+    import json
+    import multiprocessing
+    context = multiprocessing.get_context('spawn')
+    barrier = context.Barrier(3)
+    directory = tmp_path / 'standard-key'
+    generations = ['a' * 32, 'b' * 32]
+    writers = [
+        context.Process(target=_race_candidate_index, args=(directory, generation, barrier))
+        for generation in generations
+    ]
+    for process in writers:
+        process.start()
+    try:
+        for i in range(12):
+            barrier.wait(timeout=30)
+            if i:
+                with worker._cache_lock(directory):
+                    manifest = json.loads((directory / worker._MANIFEST).read_bytes())
+                    worker._checked_group(manifest, directory, 'same-variant', 'kernel')
+            barrier.wait(timeout=30)
+            with worker._cache_lock(directory):
+                manifest = json.loads((directory / worker._MANIFEST).read_bytes())
+                group = worker._checked_group(manifest, directory, 'same-variant', 'kernel')
+                generation = json.loads(Path(group['kernel.json']).read_text())['generation']
+                assert generation in generations
+                assert Path(group['kernel.npubin']).read_bytes() == b'\x7fELF' + generation.encode()
+                assert all(Path(p).parent == directory for p in group.values())
+    finally:
+        for process in writers:
+            process.join(timeout=3)
+            if process.is_alive():
+                process.terminate()
+                process.join()
+    assert [p.exitcode for p in writers] == [0, 0]

commits.message:
[PtrAnalysis](fix) restore shared pointer lowering

Restore shared pointer analysis in the Ascend lowering passes and keep
the legacy TLA entry points. Preserve bounded masks, checked origins,
position-embedding row copies and producer-local tensor views.

- Pad initialized load slices once when the consumer proves the slices
  disjoint and the padding values match. Keep per-row padding for
  overlapping, fallback and stride-two paths.
- Place checked block-pointer views at their descriptor when the remapped
  address inputs dominate it. Derive copy lengths from clamped GM origins,
  preserve static coordinates and physical pitch on singleton block
  dimensions, and use zero local offsets for aligned boundary tiles.
- Give singleton axes in tensor-of-pointers views the natural stride
  of their statically contiguous inner dimensions so DMA can identify
  a dense row. Keep the scalar offset and the explicit block pitch,
  and stop at gaps, unknown strides, empty dimensions or overflow.
- Use guarded scalar loads for eligible masked numeric singletons. Keep
  the kernel-argument base for bool bitcasts that lower to the same
  memref type and reuse carried scalar origins in nested offset loops.
- Derive atomic value-buffer layouts from the input tensor and retain the
  dynamic-offset exchange view required by the legacy A2/A3 path.
- Carry signed element offsets through loops with an invariant pointer
  base, retaining complete addresses for opaque or changing bases.
- On Ascend 950, copy active rows into a single-use fill. When the fill has
  other users, write only the masked suffix into an eligible single-use
  elementwise result.

Preserve the original regression coverage for pointer and loop lifetimes,
checked view offsets and slice bounds, atomic exchange layouts, and
row-select destinations.

Source PRs: #3291, #3314, #3336, #3377

+// Keep the address origin separate from the tile intersection: only the GM
+// view uses the nonnegative coordinate, while UB lanes retain the original
+// leading padding. Check the i32 clamp before its signed cast to index.
+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @dynamic_checked_origin(
+// CHECK-SAME: %[[SRC:[^ ,]+]]: memref<?xf32>

+// CHECK-DAG: %[[ZERO32:.*]] = arith.constant 0 : i32
+// CHECK-DAG: %[[STRIDE:.*]] = arith.constant 16 : index
+// CHECK: %[[CLAMPED32:.*]] = arith.maxsi %[[ROW]], %[[ZERO32]] : i32
+// CHECK: %[[CLAMPED:.*]] = arith.index_cast %[[CLAMPED32]] : i32 to index
+// CHECK: %[[OFFSET:.*]] = arith.muli %[[CLAMPED]], %[[STRIDE]] : index
+// CHECK: %[[INPUT:.*]] = memref.reinterpret_cast %[[SRC]] to offset: [%[[OFFSET]]], sizes: [8, 16], strides: [16, 1]

+// CHECK: memref.copy %[[GM_READ]], %[[UB_WRITE]]

+// CHECK: %[[GM_WRITE:.*]] = memref.subview %[[OUTPUT]][0, 0] [%[[COUNT]], 16] [1, 1]

+// RUN: triton-opt %s --triton-to-linalg --canonicalize --cse --verify-each --split-input-file | FileCheck %s --implicit-check-not=tt.load
+
+// These inputs are the extracted load loops produced by Unstructure. The
+// consumer replaces their tensor accumulator with a shared DMA allocation.
+// Padding may be reused only when that allocation is initialized and each
+// iteration writes a distinct slice.
+

+// CHECK-LABEL: func.func @shared_descriptor_offset

+    %ip = tt.addptr %ib, %r : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<i32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %offset = tt.load %ip : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<i32>>
+    %b = tt.splat %base : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>

+    %early = tt.addptr %b, %offset : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>
+    %v = tt.load %early : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    tt.store %op, %v : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    scf.if %pred {
+      %p = tt.addptr %b, %offset {PointerDescriptorRebuild, PointerDescriptorStructuredAxes = array<i32: 1>} : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<4xi32>

+// RUN: triton-opt %s --triton-to-unstructure --verify-each --split-input-file | FileCheck %s
+
+// Equal addresses do not allow an unconditional load when all lanes can be
+// masked. Keep the extracted predicate on the actual scalar access.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func @uniform_masked
+// CHECK: scf.for
+// CHECK: %[[MASK:.*]] = tensor.extract
+// CHECK: tt.load {{.*}}, %[[MASK]],
+// CHECK: tt.return
+tt.func @uniform_masked(%base: !tt.ptr<f32>, %mask: tensor<4xi1>) -> tensor<4xf32> {
+  %ptr = tt.splat %base : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+  %other = arith.constant dense<0.0> : tensor<4xf32>
+  %value = tt.load %ptr, %mask, %other : tensor<4x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+  tt.return %value : tensor<4xf32>
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// Zero address stride is independent of the parent-coordinate boundary.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func @zero_stride_block
+// CHECK-NOT: scf.for
+// CHECK: tt.load {{.*}} {boundaryCheck = array<i32: 0>, padding = 1 : i32}
+// CHECK: tt.return
+tt.func @zero_stride_block(%base: !tt.ptr<f32>) -> tensor<8xf32> {
+  %shape = arith.constant 3 : i64
+  %stride = arith.constant 0 : i64
+  %offset = arith.constant 0 : i32
+  %ptr = tt.make_tensor_ptr %base, [%shape], [%stride], [%offset] {order = array<i32: 0>} : <tensor<8xf32>>
+  %value = tt.load %ptr {boundaryCheck = array<i32: 0>, padding = 1 : i32} : !tt.ptr<tensor<8xf32>>
+  tt.return %value : tensor<8xf32>
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// A block coordinate is an accumulated index, not an i32 field. An unchanged
+// loop slot must reuse the original descriptor without truncating 2^31.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func @wide_invariant_block
+// CHECK: tt.advance
+// CHECK: scf.for
+// CHECK-NOT: iter_args
+// CHECK: tt.load
+// CHECK: tt.return
+tt.func @wide_invariant_block(%base: !tt.ptr<f32>, %out: !tt.ptr<f32>, %n: index) {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : index
+  %shape = arith.constant 2147483664 : i64
+  %stride = arith.constant 1 : i64
+  %offset = arith.constant 2147483647 : i32
+  %one = arith.constant 1 : i32
+  %initial = tt.make_tensor_ptr %base, [%shape], [%stride], [%offset] {order = array<i32: 0>} : <tensor<8xf32>>
+  %wide = tt.advance %initial, [%one] : <tensor<8xf32>>
+  %outs = tt.splat %out : !tt.ptr<f32> -> tensor<8x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+  %range = tt.make_range {start = 0 : i32, end = 8 : i32} : tensor<8xi32>
+  %outptr = tt.addptr %outs, %range : tensor<8x!tt.ptr<f32>>, tensor<8xi32>
+  %result = scf.for %i = %c0 to %n step %c1 iter_args(%ptr = %wide) -> !tt.ptr<tensor<8xf32>> {
+    %value = tt.load %ptr {boundaryCheck = array<i32: 0>, padding = 1 : i32} : !tt.ptr<tensor<8xf32>>
+    tt.store %outptr, %value : tensor<8x!tt.ptr<f32>>
+    scf.yield %ptr : !tt.ptr<tensor<8xf32>>
+  }
+  tt.return
+}

+// RUN: triton-opt %s --triton-to-unstructure -verify-each | FileCheck %s
+
+// Include the initial displacement on zero trips and accumulate both signed
+// element increments on every subsequent trip. The sum does not fit in i8.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func public @chained_cursor(
+// CHECK-SAME: %[[BASE:[^:]+]]: !tt.ptr<i32>
+// CHECK-DAG: %[[START:.*]] = arith.constant 7 : i64
+// CHECK-DAG: %[[STEP:.*]] = arith.constant -129 : i64
+// CHECK: %[[RESULT:.*]] = scf.for {{.*}} iter_args(%[[OFFSET:.*]] = %[[START]]) -> (i64)
+// CHECK: %[[PTR:.*]] = tt.addptr %[[BASE]], %[[OFFSET]] : !tt.ptr<i32>, i64
+// CHECK: tt.load %[[PTR]]
+// CHECK: %[[NEXT:.*]] = arith.addi %[[OFFSET]], %[[STEP]] : i64
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[NEXT]] : i64
+// CHECK: %[[FINAL:.*]] = tt.addptr %[[BASE]], %[[RESULT]] : !tt.ptr<i32>, i64
+// CHECK: tt.load %[[FINAL]]
+tt.func public @chained_cursor(%base: !tt.ptr<i32>, %out: !tt.ptr<i32>,
+    %count: i32) -> i32 {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : i32
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : i32
+  %min = arith.constant -128 : i8
+  %minus_one = arith.constant -1 : i8
+  %c7 = arith.constant 7 : i32
+  %start = tt.addptr %base, %c7 : !tt.ptr<i32>, i32
+  %result = scf.for %i = %c0 to %count step %c1
+      iter_args(%p = %start) -> (!tt.ptr<i32>) : i32 {
+    %v = tt.load %p : !tt.ptr<i32>
+    tt.store %out, %v : !tt.ptr<i32>
+    %q = tt.addptr %p, %min : !tt.ptr<i32>, i8
+    %next = tt.addptr %q, %minus_one : !tt.ptr<i32>, i8
+    scf.yield %next : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  }
+  %last = tt.load %result : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  tt.return %last : i32
+}
+
+// Both possible pointers have the same root, but the numeric analysis treats
+// the selected SSA as a fresh base. Its zero offset cannot describe this edge.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func public @opaque_offset(
+// CHECK: tt.ptr_to_int
+// CHECK: scf.for
+// CHECK: %[[SELECT:.*]] = arith.select {{.*}} : !tt.ptr<i32>
+// CHECK: %[[ADDRESS:.*]] = tt.ptr_to_int %[[SELECT]]
+// CHECK: scf.yield %[[ADDRESS]] : i64
+tt.func public @opaque_offset(%base: !tt.ptr<i32>, %count: index) -> i32 {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : index
+  %step = arith.constant 1 : i32
+  %result = scf.for %i = %c0 to %count step %c1
+      iter_args(%p = %base) -> (!tt.ptr<i32>) {
+    %advanced = tt.addptr %p, %step : !tt.ptr<i32>, i32
+    %first = arith.cmpi eq, %i, %c0 : index
+    %next = arith.select %first, %advanced, %p : !tt.ptr<i32>
+    scf.yield %next : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  }
+  %last = tt.load %result : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  tt.return %last : i32
+}
+
+// The condition forwards an offset to both the after region and loop results.
+// The backedge resets the cursor relative to the invariant base.
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func public @while_cursor(
+// CHECK-SAME: %[[WBASE:[^:]+]]: !tt.ptr<i32>
+// CHECK-DAG: %[[TWO:.*]] = arith.constant 2 : i64
+// CHECK-DAG: %[[RESET:.*]] = arith.constant 7 : i64
+// CHECK: %[[R:.*]]:2 = scf.while ({{.*}}, %[[CUR:.*]] = {{.*}}) : (i32, i64) -> (i32, i64)
+// CHECK: %[[EXIT:.*]] = arith.addi %[[CUR]], %[[TWO]] : i64
+// CHECK: scf.condition({{.*}}) {{.*}}, %[[EXIT]] : i32, i64
+// CHECK: scf.yield {{.*}}, %[[RESET]] : i32, i64
+// CHECK: %[[ENDPTR:.*]] = tt.addptr %[[WBASE]], %[[R]]#1 : !tt.ptr<i32>, i64
+// CHECK: tt.load %[[ENDPTR]]
+tt.func public @while_cursor(%base: !tt.ptr<i32>, %count: i32) -> i32 {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : i32
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : i32
+  %c2 = arith.constant 2 : i32
+  %c7 = arith.constant 7 : i32
+  %start = tt.addptr %base, %c1 : !tt.ptr<i32>, i32
+  %result:2 = scf.while (%i = %c0, %p = %start)
+      : (i32, !tt.ptr<i32>) -> (i32, !tt.ptr<i32>) {
+    %more = arith.cmpi slt, %i, %count : i32
+    %forward = tt.addptr %p, %c2 : !tt.ptr<i32>, i32
+    scf.condition(%more) %i, %forward : i32, !tt.ptr<i32>
+  } do {
+  ^bb0(%i: i32, %q: !tt.ptr<i32>):
+    %next = arith.addi %i, %c1 : i32
+    %reset = tt.addptr %base, %c7 : !tt.ptr<i32>, i32
+    scf.yield %next, %reset : i32, !tt.ptr<i32>
+  }
+  %last = tt.load %result#1 : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  tt.return %last : i32
+}

+// CHECK: tt.return

+  %five = arith.constant dense<5> : tensor<1xi64>

+  tt.return %value : tensor<1xf32>
